svg.title: Saved as Through Fire
svg.desc: A one-minute comic in 5 panels. Panel 1 (1 Corinthians 1:11-12): two Corinthian believers in a street, each shouting the name of the teacher he follows. Caption: "Corinth. Chloe’s people report quarrelling." A Corinthian says: "I follow Paul!" A Corinthian says: "I follow Apollos!" Panel 2 (1 Corinthians 3:1-3): Paul seated with a scroll, writing to the Corinthians. Caption: "From Ephesus, Paul writes to them as brothers." Paul says: "Brothers … infants in Christ … you are still of the flesh." Panel 3 (1 Corinthians 3:12-15): a house of wood and straw burning on its stone foundation, while the man who built it runs out with nothing in his hands. Caption: "Paul’s picture: on the Day, fire tests what each one built on the foundation, Jesus Christ." Paul says: "If anyone’s work is burned up, he will suffer loss, though he himself will be saved, but only as through fire." Note: "The building is the work. The builder gets out." Panel 4 (Zechariah 3:1-4): Joshua the high priest standing in filthy garments while the LORD's voice speaks from above. Caption: "Zechariah’s vision: Joshua the high priest in filthy garments." The LORD says: "Is not this a brand plucked from the fire?" The angel says: "I have taken your iniquity away from you." Panel 5 (Jude 1:22-23): one believer reaching out and pulling another away from a fire. Caption: "Jude’s picture: go after those drifting toward the fire." Jude says: "Have mercy on those who doubt; save others by snatching them out of the fire." The point: A believer who builds with the world’s wisdom is saved, but only as through fire. God plucked Joshua from the fire and clothed him clean; so go after the drifting in mercy (1 Corinthians 3:15; Jude 23).

g.text: Paul’s picture: on the Day, fire tests what
each one built on the foundation, Jesus Christ.

svg.text: A believer who builds with the world’s wisdom is saved, but only as
through fire. God plucked Joshua from the fire and clothed him clean;
so go after the drifting in mercy (1 Corinthians 3:15; Jude 23).
Panels 3 and 5 draw Paul’s and Jude’s own pictures. Satan
(Zechariah 3:1) has no recorded words and is not drawn.
